messages.content:
Find the minimum-cost path from S to G.
Terrain costs: '.' = 1, ',' = 3, '~' = 8.
Move up/down/left/right only (U = up, toward the first row; D = down; L = left; R = right).
The cost of a path is the sum of the terrain cost of every cell you enter (S itself is not counted; G costs 1).
Grid:
. S . . .
. . ~ ~ ~
~ . . , G
. ~ ~ , .
. , ~ . .

You have a tool called astar_solve that returns the exact minimum-cost path for a grid. Call it with the grid exactly as shown above, one string per row with no spaces (for example "S.,~G"). After you receive the result, reply with exactly two lines and nothing else:
PATH: <letters U/D/L/R, no separators>
COST: <integer>

function.name: astar_solve
function.description: Exact A* solver for a weighted grid. Returns the minimum-cost path as U/D/L/R letters and its total cost.

grid.description: The grid, one string per row, using only the characters . , ~ S G exactly as in the problem.
